properties.description: Patch. BL-86: the set-based schema stamp — record which types the graph carried (not just counts), so the upgrade refusal names the offending types and splits retired (migrate the graph) from unknown (update reflow2); fixes the pre-removal graph v0.10.0 refused with 'update your binary'. Also: the design-coherence CI gate now runs in the job that builds the binary (it silently never ran — FileNotFound in the no-RocksDB core job). No schema change. Supersedes v0.10.0 in place.
